howItWorks.title: How this assistant works
howItWorks.subtitle: This tool is built to be explainable, not a black box. Here's exactly what happens when you submit your symptoms.
howItWorks.step1Body: The AI reads your description and pulls out structured symptoms, duration, and severity cues — in English or German.
howItWorks.step2Body: A deterministic check runs first. If a known emergency keyword is detected, you get an instant Emergency result — no AI call, no delay.
howItWorks.step3Body: For everything else, the AI retrieves relevant reference conditions from a real medical knowledge base before reasoning — so its answer is tied to actual data, not guesswork.
howItWorks.step4Body: If the AI isn't confident, it asks a clarifying question instead of guessing — a real back-and-forth, not a single-shot answer.
howItWorks.limitation: No AI system can guarantee diagnostic accuracy. This tool is decision support, not a replacement for a licensed medical professional.
